summary: Three changes, deliberately small. 001 commits the two-line unblock plus a sse-stream FLOOR so the break cannot recur via cargo update. 002 pins a floating git dep in surreal-memory-server — gated on authorisation this phase does not have. 003 records the findings with re-run commands. No rmcp upgrade here; that is a separate phase.
warnings: AUTHORISATION GATE on 002: tools/surreal-memory-server points at Prometheus-AGS/surreal-memory-server, NOT covered by the grant (this pack + universal-agent-runtime). Silence blocks.
THE PARENT STAYS BLOCKED unless 001 lands. If 001 fails, report the parent as still blocked — not this phase as succeeding.

Review caught me calling a caret range a pin. sse-stream = "0.2.4" means ^0.2.4, so 0.2.5+ is allowed. Measured: 0.2.5 compiles, so the floor is correct — but it excludes only 0.2.0-0.2.3, not every future break.
The ContentBlock alias is verified by cargo check + 8 tests only. NO MCP server was exercised end to end.
corrections_to_assessment: Assess proposed 'commit a lockfile' for surreal-memory-server. Wrong: the lockfile IS tracked and clean. The defect is Cargo.toml:42 declaring the git dep with no rev, so cargo update floats past the lockfile. The fix is one rev= line.

adversarial_review.note: The sole CRITICAL (no falsifier) is a harness limitation: build-review-packet.sh has no child-phase support, so a PLAN was reviewed through decision mode, which requires fields plans do not have. Not papered over by bolting a falsifier onto a plan.
adversarial_review.notable: Finding 4 — I described a caret range as a pin, overstating the guarantee in exactly the way this phase exists to correct.
